text:
emily: Hey all, first day here — trying to build the inference runtime from source on WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04) with a passthrough A100. Command: `./scripts/build.sh --cuda --debug`. Hitting a ptxas error. Anyone have a quick tip? @claire

claire: welcome! :wave: Can you paste `nvcc --version` and `nvidia-smi` plus the ptxas output? WSL/CUDA combos can be finicky.

emily: nvcc:
```
nvcc: NVIDIA (R) Cuda compiler driver
Cuda compilation tools, release 11.8, V11.8.89
```

nvidia-smi:
```
Driver Version: 525.60.13
NVIDIA-SMI 525.60.13 Driver Version: 525.60.13
GPU 0: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB
```

ptxas snippet:
```
[ 11%] Building CUDA object src/runtime/CMakeFiles/runtime_cuda.dir/strided_kernels.cu.o
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: Unknown gpu architecture 'compute_80'
CMake Error at cmake/FindCUDA.cmake:1455 (message):
  ptxas died with status 1
```

claire: That error means nvcc/ptxas doesn't like the `compute_80` token being passed. Older toolchains want `sm_80` (or modern cmake integer archs). Two quick options: upgrade to CUDA 12.x in your dev image, or override the cmake arch flags.

tom: Also note WSL sometimes ends up picking the host driver vs toolkit mismatch. We normally canonicalize this with `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` in cmake/Arch.cmake. Try:
```
export CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80
cmake -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80"
cmake --build build -j8
```
That forces integer arch and an sm_80 codegen.

ops-bot: FYI \u2014 recommended dev image for A100 testing: redwood/dev:cuda-12-a100 (includes CUDA 12.1 and matching cuDNN). Using the docker image will give parity with CI.

emily: I tried `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80` then re-ran the build. Initially hit a link error because my system libcudart pointed at a different toolkit. Pulled the docker image and repeated the cmake steps inside container — got past ptxas and link.

emily: Build completed! :tada: Minimal notes I will add to onboarding: on WSL2 with passthrough A100 you either run in redwood/dev:cuda-12-a100 or set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80` and ensure the toolkit/toolchain match. I'll open a PR with the exact commands + the ptxas snippet.

claire: awesome, please tag `chore(dev): doc cuda arch a100 wsl` and ping dev-experience. Also add a one-liner about using the docker image to avoid host-toolkit drift.

devex-bot: Suggestion: put the PR in `docs/dev-setup.md` under a new subsection "GPU model pitfalls (A100, 40xx)" so the checklist shows it on new-hire runbook.

emily: will do — thanks for the quick help everyone!
